lead_raw_text:
The cubic phase Ho24Ga4 (reduced formula Ho6Ga) crystallizes in space group F-43m (No. 216) with 28 atoms in the unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Ga centers with 12 Ho neighbors, while Ho environments include a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 neighbors (8 Ho, 4 Ga) and a 16-neighbor environment of 12 Ho plus 4 Ga. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Ho polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between 12- and 16-vertex Ho polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
